comments.text:
13:18 This is no longer only affecting her, this is no longer just her addiction. This has shifted into possible grooming and unhealthy relationship behaviors. That is a child. Do it with your husband/partner if you're addicted, an ADULT who can consent and choose and is fully formed. This is the line.

And I know he said as long as you're not forcing it, but you have to remember that these children are easily susceptible and trust their mother with everything. They may not have been forced but they were definitely taught that this is normal and to seek this. 

And yes the bullying that would ensue if anyone found out would be bad, and yes about when their children start questioning things or feeling a different way. What happens if they decide that they don't want to do this anymore, whether because social or just internal and personal pressure. What happens then? What happens when they reach their cut off age but it's when she's not ready. She can easily say it's when they don't want to anymore but with addiction it's rarely that simple.

Yes these things can be tricky, but I absolutely think that this is where the line is drawn. Once again if she truly is just addicted to the feeling and the hormone release while breastfeeding then she can do it with someone who is an adult. It's probably not sexual, I absolutely love to believe that it's not sexual because it seems like it isn't and it would be even worse if it was, but that changes nothing

A very slippery slope that can send a whole family careening down a cliffside.
